BHIL · Stagehand Theme Codex · STC v1.0 · reel

Stagehand Theme Reel

Twenty motion themes from the Stagehand Theme Codex, each running as a directed loop through its slot map: hero signature, signature transition, data skin and micro-interaction. Turn the dial to see how a theme holds up in a boardroom, click a beat to jump to it, then copy the tokens or prompt seed into an agent brief.

  • FullEverything on the card: glitch, flicker, stutter and stepped frames, within the safety limits.
  • TemperedThe signature scene stays; glitch-type effects drop to short accents.
  • BoardroomThe B2B version. Themes without one play at Tempered and say so on the stage.

Every frame runs through a film pipeline tuned per theme: color grade, bloom and halation, volumetric light, lens dirt, edge chromatic aberration, grain and a focus pull on each cut. Every theme charts the same sample dataset, so data skins compare directly, and each data beat tells the same story in its own style: the chart builds, the insight lands (average line, callout, highlighted leader), then the data re-sorts and ranks. All numbers are placeholders. Codenames only: no franchise names, logos, characters or quotes.
